source: City of Lafayette Municipal Code Title 6 (https://library.municode.com/ca/lafayette/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=TIT6PLLAUS); Lafayette General Plan Density & Zoning (https://www.planlafayette.org/density-and-zoning); Lafayette General Plan Land Use Element (https://www.planlafayette.org/land-use); Zoning Regulations (https://www.lovelafayette.org/city-hall/city-departments/planning-building/zoning-regulations-handouts)

S-1.description: Single Family Residential, Very Low Density. Large lots, up to 1 du/ac.

R-20.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density. 20,000 sq ft minimum lot. Up to 2 du/ac.

R-15.description: Single Family Residential, Low-Medium Density. 15,000 sq ft minimum lot. Up to 2.9 du/ac.

R-10.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density. 10,000 sq ft minimum lot. Up to 4 du/ac.

R-7.5.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density. 7,500 sq ft minimum lot. Up to approx 5.8 du/ac.

MFR.description: Multi-Family Residential District. Allows apartments, condominiums, and townhomes. 6-21 du/ac depending on general plan sub-designation.

APO.description: Affordable Housing Overlay. Applied to sites for higher-density housing including affordable units. 20-35 du/ac.

TOD.description: Transit-Oriented Development (BART station areas). High density mixed-use. 35-75 du/ac per state TOD requirements.

C-1.description: Retail Business Commercial District. Mixed-use residential permitted in Downtown at up to 35 du/ac; standalone commercial has 0 residential density.

C-2.description: General Commercial District. Primarily non-residential commercial uses.

O.description: Administrative and Professional Office District. Office and professional uses.

P-1.description: Planned Development District. Density determined on case-by-case basis per underlying general plan designation.

A-2.description: Agricultural-Residential (2-acre minimum lot). Very low density residential with agricultural use.

C.description: Commercial (general). Commercial uses. No standalone residential permitted.

D-1.description: Downtown District 1. Downtown mixed-use area allowing residential above commercial. Up to 35 du/ac.

HPD.description: High Priority Development. Sites identified for higher-density housing per Housing Element. 20-35 du/ac.

LR-10.description: Low-density Residential (10,000 sq ft min lot). Single-family residential, up to 4 du/ac.

LR-5.description: Low-density Residential (5,000 sq ft min lot). Single-family residential, up to ~8 du/ac.

MRA.description: Multi-Family Residential A. Apartments, condominiums. 6-21 du/ac.

MRB.description: Multi-Family Residential B. Apartments, condominiums. 6-21 du/ac.

MRO.description: Multi-Family Residential-Office. Mixed residential and office uses. 6-21 du/ac.

MRP.description: Multi-Family Residential Planned. Planned multi-family development. 6-21 du/ac.

MRT.description: Multi-Family Residential Townhouse. Townhouse-style multi-family. 6-21 du/ac.

R-6.description: Single-Family Residential (6,000 sq ft min lot). Up to ~7.3 du/ac.

R-40.description: Single-Family Residential, Very Large Lot (40,000 sq ft / ~1 acre min lot). Up to ~1.1 du/ac.

R-65.description: Single-Family Residential, Estate Lot (65,000 sq ft / ~1.5 acre min lot). Up to ~0.67 du/ac.

R-100.description: Single-Family Residential, Large Estate Lot (100,000 sq ft / ~2.3 acre min lot). Up to ~0.44 du/ac.

RB.description: Recreation/Buffer. Parks, open space, and buffer areas. No residential permitted.

SRB.description: Stream/Riparian Buffer. Environmentally sensitive riparian corridor. No residential permitted.

row.description: Right-of-Way. Public streets, roads, and utility easements. No residential development permitted.
